Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:10:1.english: It has no safeguarding - For a mu'ad [forewarned ox].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:10:2.hebrew: אלא סכין - ואפילו שמרו שמירה מעולה, והפיל הכותל ויצא, חייב. ושלש מחלוקות בדבר: לר"מ, בשמירה פחותה חייב ובמעולה פטור; ולר"י, בפחותה נמי פטור; ולר"א, במעולה נמי חייב:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:10:2.english: Other than a knife - Even if he guarded it with superior safeguarding, and it knocked down the wall and went out, he is liable. And there are three [disputing] opinions on the matter: according to Rabbi Meir, with inferior safeguarding he is liable, and with superior [safeguarding] he is exempt; and according to Rabbi Yehuda, even with inferior [safeguarding] he is exempt; and according to Rabbi Eliezer, even with superior [safeguarding] he is liable.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:11:1.hebrew: לאו בחזקת שימור קיימי - אין אדם משמר שורו כלל, אלא מניחו ויוצא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:11:1.english: [They] are not presumed to be under safeguarding - A person does not guard his ox at all; rather, he leaves it and goes out.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:11:2.english: Goring with regard to an innocuous [ox], goring with regard to a forewarned [ox] - Through a verbal analogy [gezeirah shavah], so that an innocuous [ox] also requires superior safeguarding.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:12:1.hebrew: סתם שוורים בחזקת שימור קיימי - אין לך אדם שאינו משמר שורו שמירה פחותה, וחייב הכתוב בתם, אלמא שמירה מעולה בעי. הדר כתב כו':
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:12:1.english: Ordinary oxen are presumed to be under safeguarding - There is no person who does not guard his ox [with] inferior safeguarding, yet Scripture held [him] liable for an innocuous [ox] — evidently, it requires superior safeguarding. Then [Scripture] wrote, etc.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:13:1.hebrew: וכי תימא - נילף נגיחה נגיחה, דתם נמי לסגי ליה בפחותה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:13:1.english: And if you would say - let us derive [a verbal analogy from] “goring” [and] “goring,” so that for an innocuous [ox] as well, inferior [safeguarding] should suffice for it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:14:1.hebrew: והא - "לא ישמרנו" מבעי ליה ללאו, כלומר לגופיה, דאם לא שמרו שמירה מעולה ליחייב, ודרשינן ביה ריבוי אחר ריבוי, ומיעוטא דתם מנא ליה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:14:1.english: And isn't - ["and he did not guard it"] needed for the negative [statement] — that is to say, for its own [essential] meaning, that if he did not guard it with superior safeguarding, he should be liable — and [moreover] we expound from it an amplification after an amplification, so from where [does it derive] the exclusion of an innocuous [ox]?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:14:2.english: To this [one] - I have restricted [it] to inferior [safeguarding], and not to the other [ox].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:17:1.hebrew: אבל צד תמות במקומה עומדת - דלא סגי ליה בפחותה, ומשלם חצי נזק:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:17:1.english: But the element of innocuousness remains in place - For inferior [safeguarding] is not sufficient for it, and [the owner] pays half-damages.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:19:1.hebrew: אליבא דמאן - כלומר, הא ודאי לענין תשלומין לא אצטריך ליה לרב לאשמועינן דלימין נזק שלם, ולשמאל שלא הועד לה משלם חצי נזק, דהא כי האי גוונא טובא תנן, דאפילו מועד לאדם אינו מועד לבהמה, וכ"ש מועד לקרן ימין, שהוא צד חזקה שבו, אינו מועד לשמאל. אלא ודאי רב לענין שמירה אשמועינן, ואי אליבא דר"מ, הא תם ומועד לענין שמירה כי הדדי נינהו. לא גרסינן: אי אליבא דר"מ פשיטא. ואי גרסינן, הכי מפרש: אי אליבא דר"מ — ולענין שמירה לא אשמעינן רב, דהא אין חילוק בשמירתו, אלא לענין תשלומין אשמעינן — פשיטא, דהא כי האי גוונא טובא תנן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:19:1.english: In accordance with whose [opinion] - That is to say: surely with regard to payment, Rav did not need to teach us that for the right [horn] [one pays] full damages, and for the left [horn], for which it was not forewarned, one pays half damages — for we have learned many [cases] like this [in the Mishnah], that even [an ox] forewarned for a human is not forewarned for an animal, and all the more so [an ox] forewarned for the right horn, which is its strong side, is not forewarned for the left [horn]. Rather, Rav certainly taught us [this] with regard to safeguarding; and if [this is] according to Rabbi Meir, behold, an innocuous [ox] and a forewarned [ox] are alike with regard to safeguarding. We do not have the reading: "If according to Rabbi Meir, it is obvious." And if we do have [that] reading, it is explained thus: "If according to Rabbi Meir" — and Rav did not teach us [this] with regard to safeguarding, since there is no difference in its safeguarding, rather he taught us [this] with regard to payment — "it is obvious," for we have learned many [cases] like this [in the Mishnah].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:19:2.hebrew: אלא אליבא דר"י - ואשמועינן רב דאם שמרו שמירה פחותה ויצא והזיק בקרן ימין שהועד לה, פטור, דמועד בשמירה פחותה סגיא ליה; ואם נגח בשמאל, חייב, דתם לא אמעיט לשמירה פחותה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:19:2.english: Rather, [it is] in accordance with [the opinion of] Rabbi Yehuda - and Rav teaches us that if [the owner] guarded it with an inferior safeguarding, and it went out and caused damage with the right horn, for which it had been forewarned, he is exempt, for an inferior safeguarding suffices for a forewarned [ox]; and if it gored with the left [horn], he is liable, for an innocuous [ox] was not excluded [so as to suffice] with an inferior safeguarding.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:19:3.hebrew: מאי אריא קרן שמאל - דאי נגח בה חייב חצי נזק? כי נגח בימין נמי, איכא צד תמות ומועדת: לחציו פטור ולחציו חייב, דהא צד תמות במקומה עומדת, ואשתכח דהכא נמי חצי נזק משלם, ומאי נפקא לן מדרב:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:19:3.english: Why specifically the left horn - that if it gored with it, [the owner] is liable for half damages? Even when it gores with the right [horn], there is [both] an element of innocuousness and [an element of] forewarning: for half of it he is exempt and for half of it he is liable, for the element of innocuousness remains in its place, and it turns out that here too he pays half damages — so what practical difference does Rav's [statement] make to us?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:1:1.hebrew: דאמר שוכר כשומר חנם דמי - בבבא מציעא בהשואל (ד' צה:), ונתני חוץ משומר חנם והשוכר:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:1:1.english: Who says [that] a renter is like an unpaid bailee - [This is stated] in Bava Metzia, in [the chapter] HaShoel (95b); and let [the Mishnah] teach: "with the exception of an unpaid bailee and a renter."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:20:1.hebrew: לית ליה דרב אדא - אלא לגמרי פטר ביה ר"י, ואשמעינן רב דכי האי גוונא משכחת צד תמות ומועדת בחד תורא, ולענין שמירה: דאם שמרו שמירה פחותה והזיק בקרן ימין, פטור לגמרי, ואם בשמאל, משלם חצי נזק:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:20:1.english: He does not hold [the opinion] of Rav Adda - Rather, Rabbi Yehuda completely exempts [the owner] in [that case]. And Rav teaches us that in a case such as this, you find an element of innocuousness and [an element of] forewarnedness in one ox, with respect to guarding: that if he guarded it with an inferior guarding and it caused damage with the right horn, he is completely exempt; and if [it caused damage] with the left [horn], he pays half-damages.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:2:1.hebrew: ואי כר"י - היכא דשמרו שמירה פחותה, אמאי משלמים כופר? האמר ר"י מועד סגי ליה בשמירה פחותה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:2:1.english: And if [it is] in accordance with Rabbi Yehudah - Where they guarded it [with] an inferior safeguarding, why do they pay ransom? Did not Rabbi Yehudah say [that for] a forewarned [ox], an inferior safeguarding suffices for it?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:3:1.hebrew: ר"א היא דאמר - במתניתין: אין לו שמירה למועד אלא סכין, ואפילו שמירה מעולה, וכ"ש האי דשמירה פחותה נטריה, ומשום הכי משלמין כופר. ולענין דמי שור נמי חייבין, דעליהן לשומרו שמירה מעולה הואיל ונושאי שכר הן. ובדנטריה שמירה מעולה לא מצי מוקים לה אפילו לר"א, דאע"ג דלענין כופר חייבין דלא סגי ליה בשמירה מעולה, לענין דמי שור לבעלים פטורין, דהא נטרוהו ומאי הוה להו למיעבד:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:3:1.english: It is Rabbi Eliezer, who says - in the Mishnah: A mu'ad [forewarned ox] has no safeguarding other than a knife, and even superior safeguarding [does not suffice], and all the more so this [case], where he guarded it with inferior safeguarding, and therefore they pay kofer [ransom]. And with regard to the value of the ox [itself], they are also liable, because it is incumbent upon them to guard it with superior safeguarding since they are paid bailees. And he could not establish [the baraita] as [dealing with a case] where he guarded it with superior safeguarding, even according to Rabbi Eliezer; for although with regard to kofer they would be liable, since superior safeguarding does not suffice for it, with regard to the value of the ox to the owner they would be exempt, for they guarded it, and what [else] could they have done?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:3:2.hebrew: אלא סכין - ואפילו שמרו שמירה מעולה, והפיל הכותל ויצא, חייב. ושלש מחלוקות בדבר: לר"מ, בשמירה פחותה חייב ובמעולה פטור; ולר"י, בפחותה נמי פטור; ולר"א, במעולה נמי חייב:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:3:2.english: Other than a knife - Even if he guarded it with superior safeguarding, and it knocked down the wall and went out, he is liable. And there are three [disputed] opinions in the matter: according to Rabbi Meir, with inferior safeguarding he is liable, and with superior [safeguarding] he is exempt; and according to Rabbi Yehuda, even with inferior [safeguarding] he is exempt; and according to Rabbi Eliezer, even with superior [safeguarding] he is liable.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:7:1.hebrew: וסתמא דמילתא - שור נגחן, כי מקבל איניש נטירותיה עליה, למה שהוא מוחזק מקבל עליה — דלא לזיק אחריני; אבל דלא ליזקיה אחריני לא מסיק אדעתיה, שהרי אין שור מתיצב לנגדו מפחדו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:7:1.english: And the normal way of things [is] - [With] a goring ox, when a person accepts its guarding upon himself, he accepts [responsibility] upon himself for that which it is presumed [to do] — that it should not injure others; but that others should not injure it does not enter his mind, for no ox stands up against it out of fear of it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:8:1.hebrew: ונעל בפניו כראוי - היינו שמירה פחותה — דלת שיכולה לעמוד ברוח מצויה — לקמן בהכונס (בבא קמא דף נה:):
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:8:1.english: And locked [the gate] before it in an appropriate manner - This is [considered] an inferior level of guarding — a door that can withstand an ordinary wind — [as stated] later in [the chapter] HaKones (Bava Kamma 55b).

Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:9:1.hebrew: ולא ישמרנו בעליו - במועד כתיב, מיעט הכתוב לשמירה מועטת, כדמפרש בגמרא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 45b:9:1.english: And its owner has not guarded it - [This] is written regarding a forewarned [ox]; Scripture limited [the requirement] to minimal guarding, as is explained in the Gemara.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 45b:11:1.hebrew: בחזקת שימור קיימי - אין הפירוש כההיא דפ"ק (ד' טו.) גבי פלוגתא דפלגא נזקא קנסא, ד"בחזקת שימור" דהתם היינו דאין צריכין שימור שאין דרכו להזיק כמו שן ורגל; אבל "חזקת שימור" דהכא היינו שדרך בני אדם לשומרו, וסתם עביד להו שמירה פחותה. ור"ת גרס בדר' מאיר "בחזקת שימור", ובדרבי יהודה "לאו בחזקת שימור". ולפי הגיר' הכי פירושו: "מאי טעמא דר' מאיר? קסבר סתם שוורים בחזקת שימור חשיבי לבעלים" — שסבורין הבעלים שאין דרכן להזיק, ועל כן אינם חוששין לשומרם; "וטעמא דר"י: סתם שוורים לאו בחזקת שימור חשיבי לבעלים", ונטרי להו שמירה פחותה. ולהך גירסא הוי פירוש "חזקת שימור" דהכא כ"חזקת שימור" דפ"ק; ומיהו בין לר"מ בין לר"י סברי שפיר פלגא נזקא קנסא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 45b:11:1.english: "Presumed to be under safeguarding" - The meaning is not like that [expression] in the first chapter (15a) regarding the dispute [over whether] half-damages are a fine, for "presumed to be under safeguarding" there means that they do not need safeguarding, as it is not their nature to cause damage, like Tooth and Foot; rather, "presumed to be under safeguarding" here means that it is the custom of people to guard it, and ordinarily they provide them with a reduced [level of] safeguarding. And Rabbeinu Tam reads in Rabbi Meir's [opinion] "presumed to be under safeguarding," and in Rabbi Yehudah's [opinion] "not presumed to be under safeguarding." And according to [this] reading, this is its explanation: "What is the reason of Rabbi Meir? He holds [that] ordinary oxen are considered by the owners to be in a state of safeguarding" — for the owners think that it is not their nature to cause damage, and therefore they are not concerned to guard them; "and the reason of Rabbi Yehudah [is that] ordinary oxen are not considered by the owners to be in a state of safeguarding," and [therefore] they guard them with a reduced [level of] safeguarding. And according to this reading, the meaning of "presumed to be under safeguarding" here is like "presumed to be under safeguarding" in the first chapter; however, both according to Rabbi Meir and according to Rabbi Yehudah, they can indeed hold [that] half-damages are a fine.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 45b:14:1.hebrew: והא מיבעי ליה ללאו - נראה כגירסת הספרים דגרסי "והא מיבעי ליה לגופיה", כלומר לריבוי אחר ריבוי:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 45b:14:1.english: But isn’t it necessary for the negative [lav]? — The reading of the texts that read “But isn’t it necessary for itself [legufei]” appears [preferable], meaning, for an inclusion after an inclusion.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 45b:17:1.hebrew: לא פטר ר"י אלא צד העדאה שבו - מסברא אומר כן, דאטו משום שנעשה מועד גרע ויפטר אפילו מח"נ בשמירה פחותה? וא"ת: התינח לחומרא, דאית לן למימר צד תמות במקומה עומדת מסברא כדפרישית, אלא לקולא — דאין משתלם אלא מגופו ואין מעמידין אפוטרופוס — מנלן? וי"ל: הואיל דצריכין אנו לומר צד תמות במקומה עומדת לחומרא, ה"ה לקולא. ומיהו ליפטר בהודאתו, למ"ד פלגא נזקא קנסא, לא אמרינן במקומה עומדת, דכיון דאייעד לאו קנסא הוא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 45b:17:1.english: "Rabbi Yehuda deemed only the forewarned element of it exempt" - He says this based on reasoning, for is it the case that because it became forewarned it is worse off and should be exempt even from half-damages with inferior guarding? And if you say: This works well for stringency, where we must say that the element of innocuousness remains in place based on reasoning, as I explained; but for leniency — that it is paid only from its own body, and that a guardian is not appointed [for it] — from where do we know [this]? And one can say [in answer]: Since we must say that the element of innocuousness remains in place for stringency, the same applies for leniency. However, regarding being exempt through one's own admission, according to the one who says half-damages is a fine, we do not say [that the element of innocuousness] remains in place, because once it has become forewarned it is no longer a fine.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 45b:18:1.hebrew: מועד לקרן ימין - מצינו למימר דדוקא נקט, לפי שקרן ימין מזומן להזיק יותר מקרן של שמאל, אבל מועד לקרן שמאל — כ"ש דמועד לקרן ימין; או שמא אין מועד, ואורחא דמילתא נקט:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 45b:18:1.english: Forewarned with regard to [its] right horn - We can say that [Rav] specifically stated [this case], because the right horn is more prone to cause damage than the left horn, whereas [if it is] forewarned with regard to the left horn — all the more so is it forewarned with regard to the right horn; or perhaps it is not forewarned [with regard to the right horn], and [Rav] merely stated the typical case.
